description: Mixed conceptual and competitive-exam oriented Machine Learning questions.

questions.questionText: Which learning type uses labeled training examples?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is Supervised learning. This is a fundamental Machine Learning concept.

questions.questionText: Which learning type commonly includes clustering?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is Unsupervised learning. This is a fundamental Machine Learning concept.

questions.questionText: Which task predicts a continuous numerical value?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is Regression. This is a fundamental Machine Learning concept.

questions.questionText: Which task assigns examples to categories?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is Classification. This is a fundamental Machine Learning concept.

questions.questionText: Which metric is the harmonic mean of precision and recall?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is F1-score. This is a fundamental Machine Learning concept.

questions.questionText: Which algorithm is based on nearest training examples?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is KNN. This is a fundamental Machine Learning concept.

questions.questionText: Which algorithm uses a margin and support vectors?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is SVM. This is a fundamental Machine Learning concept.

questions.questionText: Which algorithm partitions data into K clusters using centroids?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is K-means. This is a fundamental Machine Learning concept.

questions.questionText: Which technique is commonly used to reduce dimensionality using principal components?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is PCA. This is a fundamental Machine Learning concept.

questions.questionText: Which method combines many randomized decision trees?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is Random Forest. This is a fundamental Machine Learning concept.

questions.questionText: Which technique builds models sequentially to correct previous errors?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is Boosting. This is a fundamental Machine Learning concept.

questions.questionText: Which algorithm is an example of boosting?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is AdaBoost. This is a fundamental Machine Learning concept.

questions.questionText: Which technique combines multiple bootstrap-trained models?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is Bagging. This is a fundamental Machine Learning concept.

questions.questionText: What is a common purpose of regularization?
questions.optionB: Reduce overfitting by penalizing model complexity
questions.optionC: Increase training error deliberately without purpose
questions.explanation: Correct answer is Reduce overfitting by penalizing model complexity. This is a fundamental Machine Learning concept.

questions.questionText: What happens when a model overfits?
questions.optionC: It performs well on training data but poorly on unseen data
questions.optionD: It performs poorly on all data only
questions.explanation: Correct answer is It performs well on training data but poorly on unseen data. This is a fundamental Machine Learning concept.

questions.questionText: What is cross-validation mainly used for?
questions.optionD: Estimating generalization performance and tuning model choices
questions.explanation: Correct answer is Estimating generalization performance and tuning model choices. This is a fundamental Machine Learning concept.

questions.questionText: Which method is especially associated with image processing in deep learning?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is Convolutional Neural Network. This is a fundamental Machine Learning concept.

questions.questionText: Which architecture is designed for sequential data?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is Recurrent Neural Network. This is a fundamental Machine Learning concept.

questions.questionText: What is the purpose of an activation function in a neural network?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is Introduce nonlinear behavior. This is a fundamental Machine Learning concept.

questions.questionText: What is backpropagation used to compute?
questions.optionD: Gradients of the loss with respect to model parameters
questions.explanation: Correct answer is Gradients of the loss with respect to model parameters. This is a fundamental Machine Learning concept.

questions.questionText: Which technique can map high-dimensional data to fewer dimensions for visualization?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is t-SNE. This is a fundamental Machine Learning concept.

questions.questionText: Which clustering algorithm can identify noise points and does not require specifying the number of clusters in advance?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is DBSCAN. This is a fundamental Machine Learning concept.

questions.questionText: Which model commonly uses Bayes' theorem with conditional independence assumptions?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is Naive Bayes. This is a fundamental Machine Learning concept.

questions.questionText: Which method can set some linear model coefficients exactly to zero through L1 regularization?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is Lasso. This is a fundamental Machine Learning concept.

questions.questionText: Which is the main goal of machine learning?
questions.optionA: Learn useful patterns from data to make predictions or decisions on new examples
questions.explanation: Correct answer is Learn useful patterns from data to make predictions or decisions on new examples. This is a fundamental Machine Learning concept.
